description: Live rooms and prices at ONE hotel the traveller already has in mind, for their dates and number of guests, without searching the whole town. Pass the reference you hold: a Vuelo hotel link (https://…/h/…), an offerId from an earlier Vuelo search, a Vuelo property_id (VHP_…) or a hotel id from a Vuelo search. Use it when the traveller shares a Vuelo hotel link or asks about the same hotel on other dates. The result appears in the Vuelo card. No result means the hotel has nothing for those dates or is not one Vuelo can sell: say so, and offer to search the town. Prices hold for about an hour: book soon after, or check again.
